This single-panel figure is produced by
[`script/FigureS3.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/FigureS3.R).
It shows the final full row-centered matrix, with all 200 GPs and all 107
observed level-2 clusters. The analysis uses healthy non-thymocyte cells
(`condition_broad == "healthy"` and `annotation_level1 != "thymocyte"`). For
each GP, its mean loading across clusters is subtracted from every cluster
mean, so a row says where a program is more or less active than its own
average rather than how large its loading is. The centered color scale is
fixed at -0.2 to 0.2; values outside this range are saturated at the endpoint
colors. It is the cluster counterpart of
[Extended Data Figure 5](FigureS5.html), which shows the tissue-associated GPs
across tissues and lineages, and the mean-loading counterpart of
[Extended Data Figure 6](FigureS6.html), which resolves the same clusters cell
by cell.
